{{Current events|year=2019|month=05|day=30|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
* An explosive device is detonated in a commercial center in the [[Colombia]]n city of [[Cúcuta]], on the border with [[Venezuela]], with at least 12 injured. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20190531/462576819598/detonacion-de-un-explosivo-causa-12-heridos-en-frontera-con-venezuela.html (''La Vanguardia'')] [https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/al-menos-12-heridos-deja-explosion-en-frontera-entre-colombia-y-venezuela (''El Universal'')]

;Health and environment
*A study, published in the journal ''[[Science (journal)|Science]]'', finds a [[Genetic engineering|genetically enhanced]] fungus that produces spider toxin  can rapidly kill huge numbers of the mosquitoes that spread [[malaria]]. Trials held  in [[Burkina Faso]] showed mosquito populations collapsed by 99% within 45 days. The fungus did not affect other insects, such as bees. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-48464510 (BBC)] [https://science.sciencemag.org/content/364/6443/894 (''Science'')]
*[[Measles resurgence in the United States]]
**Sixty new cases in the past week are reported, bringing this year's total to 971 cases in 26 U.S. states – the highest since 1994. The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|CDC]] warns, "If these outbreaks continue through summer and fall, the United States may lose its [[Measles#Americas|measles elimination status]]." [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48468801 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Mexico–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a 5% import tariff on all products from Mexico, effective June 10 and rising in steps to 25% by October, "until the illegal immigration problem is remedied". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48469408 (BBC News)]
**[[President of Mexico|Mexican President]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] responds with a letter to the U.S. president stating  he wants to avoid a confrontation, saying that ideals such as justice and universal brotherhood are more important than borders. He  also ordered his [[Secretary of Foreign Affairs (Mexico)|foreign minister]] to travel to Washington on Friday. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-mexico-president/america-first-is-a-fallacy-mexicos-president-responds-to-trump-tariff-idUSKCN1T109N?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*American songwriter [[R. Kelly]] is charged by [[Chicago]] prosecutors with 11 counts of sexual assault and abuse. [https://ew.com/music/2019/05/30/r-kelly-charged-11-new-counts-of-sexual-assault-abuse-chicago/ (''Entertainment Weekly'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2019/may/30/r-kelly-chicago-prosecutors-sex-related-charges (''The Guardia''n)]
*[[Sinking of Hableány|Sinking of ''Hableány'']]
**The captain of the M/V ''Viking Sigyn'' that was involved in the deadly sinking of the ''Hableány'' is questioned and arrested by the [[Rendőrség|Hungarian police]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48468701 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Papua New Guinea]]
**[[James Marape]] is elected [[Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea|Prime Minister]] by the [[National Parliament of Papua New Guinea|National Parliament]] following the resignation of [[Peter O'Neill]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-05-30/papua-new-guinea-announce-new-pm-james-marape/11163006 (ABC)]
*[[Abortion in the United States by state]]
**[[List of governors of Louisiana|Louisiana Governor]] [[John Bel Edwards]] signs a [[heartbeat bill]] that bans abortion as early as six weeks into pregnancy. The law’s effective date is tied to a similar Mississippi law which has already been temporarily blocked by a federal court. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48468962 (BBC)]
*[[Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**Fifteen days after the first wave of protests, millions of students, schoolteachers and university professors hold demonstrations in over a hundred [[Brazil|Brazilian]] cities against massive cuts in the education budget. Brazilian Education Minister Abraham Weintraub accuses teachers of "coercing" students into participating in the protests. [https://amp.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/31/students-protest-across-brazil-over-jair-bolsonaros-sweeping-cuts-to-education (The Guardian)]
*[[African Continental Free Trade Agreement]]
**With the ratification of the [[African Continental Free Trade Agreement]] (AfCFTA) by [[Gambia]] on April 30, 2019, 22 countries have deposited their instruments of ratification to the [[African Union]] (AU), meeting the threshold for the agreement to come into effect. The AfCFTA entered into force on May 30, 2019.

;Sports
*[[2019 NBA Finals]]
**The [[Toronto Raptors]] host the first [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) [[NBA Finals|finals game]] in their franchise history, against the [[Golden State Warriors]], and the first outside the United States in NBA history at the [[Scotiabank Arena]] in [[Toronto]]. The Raptors won 118–109. [https://www.npr.org/2019/05/30/728387028/nba-finals-head-to-canada-as-raptors-take-on-golden-state-warriors (NPR)]
